title: A batch of server journey steps
description: The body of POST /v1/steps (server secret; gzip with Content-Encoding: gzip, or plain JSON): what the host's server saw of its signed-in people - one step per page shown or write taken. Route names, statuses, timings and the NAMES of refused fields only: never a value, a message or a URL. Each step stands alone: a bad one is refused and named by its index, the rest are kept. A repeated id is a no-op (the SDK retries).

id.description: A UUID the SDK mints: the same step sent twice is kept once.

subject.description: The person, as the host's id (the client token's sub).

subject_since.description: When the person's account was made, unix ms: a key flow with new_account_days starts only for people that new.

visit.description: The recording's id while the browser records (X-Recording-Id), else srv- and 16 hex of a hash of the session id. Detection does not trust it: a visit is one person's steps with no pause over 30 minutes.

request.description: The request's id as the host's log lines carry it (the answer's X-Request-Id: mybeast/logs-laravel sets it), so its step opens exactly its lines in Logs. Leave it out when there is none: a service from before 28.10.2026 refuses the field.

at.description: When the request came in, the server's clock, unix ms.

kind.description: visit: a page shown; save: a write taken; refused: a write sent back (its errors, a 4xx); error: the server failed (5xx); blocked: not let in (401/403/404/405/419/429).

route.description: The route's NAME (`tenants.store`), never its URL: no slash, no space.

page.description: The host's page name (an Inertia component, `Tenant::Leases/Show`), when it knows it: no space, so never a sentence.

data_read.description: A visit that read a sheet's or a list's data (JSON), not a page: a key flow may count it, the loop rule does not.
